summary.motive: Distribute the ball to whichever shallow receiver wins his individual leverage race, reading defenders rather than landmarks.
summary.whyItWorks: Two staggered crossing layers mean any defender who covers one has turned his back on the other; the quarterback simply throws to the uncovered lever.
summary.failureMode: Zone defenders trade assignments without turning their heads, keeping a fresh body square to the quarterback in both lanes.

beats.title: 1. The Verticals Clear the Stage
beats.text: Both slots fire instant seams while the flanker pins the corner, dragging every deep and hook defender away from the middle of the field.

beats.title: 2. The Near Shallow Departs
beats.text: The split end drives his six-yard shallow across the formation. The Mike takes one step with it — exactly the bait the Air Raid wants.

beats.title: 3. The Deep Layer Crosses Behind
beats.text: Four yards deeper, the drive route crosses directly beneath the first. The nickel who chased Y vertically is now trailing by a full body.

beats.title: 4. Leverage Read Complete
beats.text: With the near layer defended over the top and the deep layer trailed from behind, the quarterback throws to whichever shallow ran away from its leverage.

relations.tell: The two crossers never converge at one point — they stay four yards apart in depth for the entire route.
